phases.title: 1 · Foundations
phases.goal: Tooling, design system, money math and one calculation path.

phases.title: 2 · Core experience (demo data)
phases.goal: Every section of the app working end to end on demo data.

phases.title: 3 · Marketplace integrations
phases.goal: Real orders from Amazon and Flipkart, safely and idempotently.

phases.title: 4 · Accounts & security
phases.goal: Sign-in, workspaces and roles so real data can be deployed safely.

phases.title: 5 · Real-data financials
phases.goal: Costs, fees and settlements from real data; reconciliation.

phases.title: 6 · Operational workflows
phases.goal: Imports, product management and actionable insights.

phases.title: 7 · Quality & launch
phases.goal: Docs, verification, end-to-end tests and production readiness.

steps.title: Project tooling & quality gates
steps.summary: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 6 strict (noUncheckedIndexedAccess), Tailwind 3, ESLint flat config for eslint-config-next 16, Vitest 5. The four quality commands every change must pass.
acceptance: npm run typecheck passes with 0 errors
npm run lint passes with 0 warnings
npm test passes
npm run build succeeds

acceptance: Status is always icon + text, never colour alone
Focus rings visible on every interactive element
Chart palette validated for colour-vision deficiency

steps.title: Money & finance domain module
steps.summary: Integer-paise Money class on decimal.js, Indian digit grouping, compact INR, profit chain (net sales → gross → contribution → net), margin, % and pp change, ROAS/ACOS, return rate, stock math, largest-remainder allocation.
acceptance: No JavaScript number used for authoritative money math
Missing COGS makes profit unknown, never zero
Zero/negative denominators return null

steps.title: IST calendar & safe URL parsing
steps.summary: All business days are IST day keys; ranges are whole inclusive days; previous-period ranges; allow-list parsing of every query param.
acceptance: 7D always means 7 whole IST days regardless of server timezone
Custom ranges validated (start ≤ end, end ≤ today, ≤ 366 days)

steps.title: Deterministic demo dataset
steps.summary: Seeded Acme Commerce India workspace: 25 products, ~190 orders over 95 days, returns, settlements with discrepancies, ad campaigns, expenses. Records only, never KPIs.
acceptance: Same seed produces an identical dataset
Shape matches the spec (25 products, 100–200 orders, all 4 channels)

steps.title: Ledger: one calculation path
steps.summary: services/ledger.ts converts records into line/return/ad/expense facts once; every page and report aggregates them with the same formulas so totals reconcile.
acceptance: Marketplace rows + shared overhead = workspace total
Σ product profit − unallocated expenses = workspace net profit
P&L export equals the dashboard

steps.title: Overview KPIs with honest comparisons
steps.summary: Six KPI cards (net sales, gross profit, net profit, margin, inventory value, settlement pending) with definitions, deltas vs the previous equal period and sparklines. No fabricated comparison when the prior period predates history.
acceptance: Net sales equals an independent recomputation from raw orders
90-day view shows 'No prior-period history'
Margin change shown in percentage points

steps.title: Reports & safe CSV exports
steps.summary: Nine CSV reports (P&L, products, marketplaces, inventory, low stock, settlements, returns, advertising, orders) respecting filters, with spreadsheet formula-injection escaping.
acceptance: Every report builds
Cells beginning = + - @ are neutralised
P&L export matches the dashboard

steps.title: Report viewer: on-screen tables, charts & totals
steps.summary: Every report can be viewed in the app, not only downloaded: summary figures, a chart suited to the report, a sortable and paginated table with a totals row, the metric definitions, CSV download and print. Same data and numbers as the CSV export, filtered by date range and marketplace.
acceptance: Every report has a View page reachable from /reports
Table rows and values match the CSV export exactly
Totals row equals the sum of its column (decimal-exact) and is only shown where summing is meaningful
Sorting by any column and pagination work
Each report shows summary figures and an appropriate chart
Empty periods show a clear empty state
Print shows only the report content

steps.title: Database: Prisma 7 + Neon schema & migrations
steps.summary: Workspace, MarketplaceConnection, OAuthState, ExternalOrder, ExternalOrderItem and SyncRun tables with workspace-scoped unique keys; batched upserts with explicit UTC timestamps.
acceptance: Migration applied to the Neon dev database
Bulk upsert of 100 orders is idempotent and fast
Timestamps round-trip exactly in IST and UTC

steps.title: Token encryption & OAuth hardening
steps.summary: AES-256-GCM token encryption; OAuth state that is random, hashed, single-use, 10-minute and browser-bound; POST-only, origin-checked state-changing routes.
acceptance: Tokens never stored in plaintext
Replayed, expired or cross-browser callbacks are rejected

steps.title: Amazon SP-API adapter (Orders 2026-01-01)
steps.summary: Seller Central India consent flow, LWA code exchange and refresh, searchOrders on the EU endpoint without buyer PII, status and money mapping, resumable cursor. Built against Amazon's published model; not yet run live (see I-08).
acceptance: No BUYER/RECIPIENT datasets requested
Pagination and resume cursor work
Malformed responses are rejected

steps.title: Flipkart Seller API adapter (Shipments v3)
steps.summary: Authorization-code flow with Basic client auth, six-segment rolling 30-day window, item grouping and order-status derivation, nextPageUrl host guard. Five assumptions marked VERIFY IN SANDBOX (see I-09).
acceptance: All six filter segments walked
Foreign-host pagination URLs refused
Cancelled items excluded from value

steps.title: Sync engine
steps.summary: Provider-agnostic, idempotent, resumable sync with 8-page / 8-second budgets, run locking, token refresh, reauth detection and batched page saves.
acceptance: Re-sync never duplicates
Progress kept on rate limits and failures
Items merged across pages

steps.title: Integrations page & synced Orders tab
steps.summary: Honest connection states (not configured with missing variable names, not connected, connected, reconnect required), connect/sync/disconnect, Demo/Synced source switch on Orders.
acceptance: Never shows 'Connected' without stored tokens
Demo and synced orders are never mixed

steps.title: Revoked access → 'Reconnect required'
steps.summary: When a seller revokes access, token services reply 400 invalid_grant to the refresh call; today that shows 'sync failed'. Treat invalid_grant from the refresh call as unauthorized so the card asks to reconnect.
acceptance: Refresh returning 400 invalid_grant marks the connection REAUTH_REQUIRED
Other 400 errors still report a generic failure

steps.title: First live Amazon connection (Draft app)
steps.summary: Register the SP-API app, connect a real seller account with version=beta, sync and spot-check orders against Seller Central (checklist in docs/07 §7.9).
acceptance: Consent → callback → 'Connected' with seller id
Five orders match Seller Central exactly
Revoked app shows 'Reconnect required'
manualQa: Spot-check 5 orders against Seller Central
steps.blockedReason: Needs Amazon SP-API developer registration and app credentials; real data should not go on a public deployment before login (A-01).

steps.title: Flipkart sandbox verification
steps.summary: Run the adapter against the Flipkart sandbox and confirm the five VERIFY IN SANDBOX assumptions (token method, refresh grant, nextPageUrl format, sellingPrice semantics, orderDate filter on all segments).
acceptance: All five assumptions confirmed or code adjusted with tests
manualQa: Compare sandbox orders with Seller Hub
steps.blockedReason: Needs a Flipkart third-party application and sandbox credentials.

steps.title: Scheduled background sync
steps.summary: Netlify Scheduled Function that runs the existing lock-protected, resumable sync for every connected account (e.g. every 15 minutes).
acceptance: Runs unattended and resumes partial syncs
Overlapping runs are prevented
Failures recorded in SyncRun with safe messages

steps.title: Synced order detail page
steps.summary: Detail view for synced orders: items, SKU/ASIN/FSN, raw marketplace status history, last sync, link to the marketplace order.
acceptance: No buyer PII displayed
Unknown values shown as unknown

steps.title: Publish Amazon app to the Appstore
steps.summary: Pass Amazon's app review and data-protection requirements so any seller can connect; remove version=beta.
acceptance: App published; AMAZON_SPAPI_DRAFT_APP=false in production

steps.title: Shopify adapter
steps.summary: Third marketplace via the Shopify Admin API behind the existing adapter port (docs/07 §7.10).
acceptance: Orders sync idempotently
No changes needed to the sync engine

steps.title: Authentication (sign-in)
steps.summary: Auth.js sign-in (Google and/or email), session middleware for all product routes, sign-out. Unblocks safe deployment with real data.
acceptance: Every product route requires a session
Session cookies are httpOnly and secure
Unauthenticated API calls return 401

steps.title: Workspaces, membership & roles
steps.summary: User, WorkspaceMember and roles (Owner, Admin, Analyst, Viewer); getCurrentWorkspace() resolves the signed-in member's workspace; role checks on mutations.
acceptance: User A cannot read or write user B's workspace (tested)
Workspace id never taken from the request

steps.title: Audit log
steps.summary: AuditLog for connects, disconnects, settlement adjustments and stock edits: actor, time, before/after, reason.
acceptance: Every financial or stock mutation writes an audit entry

steps.title: Rate limiting & security headers
steps.summary: Per-user/IP limits on connect, sync and import routes; Content-Security-Policy and related headers; partial unique index for the sync lock.
acceptance: Abusive request bursts are throttled
CSP blocks inline script injection

steps.title: Products & unit costs in the database
steps.summary: Persist products, listings per channel and unit costs; map synced SKUs/ASINs/FSNs to products so COGS is known.
acceptance: Unmapped SKUs are flagged, never costed at zero
Cost changes are audited

steps.title: Order costs from marketplaces
steps.summary: Record commission, closing fees, shipping and gateway fees per order (OrderCost) from marketplace data, marked recorded vs estimated.
acceptance: No fee is counted twice
Estimated costs are labelled

steps.title: Dashboard on real data
steps.summary: Ledger reads facts from the database (SQL aggregation + cache) instead of the demo seed; demo stays as its own workspace.
acceptance: All reconciliation tests pass on database-backed data
Demo and real workspaces never mix

steps.title: Settlement data import
steps.summary: Import settlement batches and transactions from Amazon Finances / settlement reports and Flipkart payments, idempotently.
acceptance: Re-import never duplicates transactions
Settlements never counted as sales

steps.title: Settlement matching engine
steps.summary: Four-step matching priority (exact txn ref → order ref + type → amount + date tolerance → manual review); one-to-many and many-to-one; method and confidence recorded.
acceptance: Ambiguous matches are never auto-reconciled
Difference = actual − expected everywhere

steps.title: Manual review workflow
steps.summary: Review queue for differences with required explanation, SettlementAdjustment and audit entry.
acceptance: Explanation required for every manual adjustment
Every adjustment is audited

steps.title: Expenses entry
steps.summary: Record operating expenses with optional marketplace; shared overhead stays unallocated.
acceptance: Overhead never allocated to channels or products

steps.title: Returns sync
steps.summary: Flipkart returns API and Amazon returns data feeding ReturnRecord with recovery status.
acceptance: Return losses follow the documented policy

steps.title: Advertising data import
steps.summary: Advertising CSV import and later the Amazon Ads API, feeding AdvertisingDailyMetric.
acceptance: Attribution caveat shown with every ROAS/ACOS

steps.title: CSV import pipeline
steps.summary: Upload → preview → column mapping → validation → duplicate detection → confirm → summary, for orders, settlements and ads; size/row limits; CsvImportJob history.
acceptance: Invalid and duplicate rows reported per row
Import is transactional and idempotent

steps.title: Product & stock management
steps.summary: Add/edit products, stock adjustments with movement history, reorder thresholds, no negative stock unless backorders are enabled.
acceptance: Every stock change creates a movement
Negative stock blocked by default

steps.title: Insight lifecycle & fee rule
steps.summary: Persist insights with read/resolved state and creation time; add the spec's 'unusually high marketplace fees' rule.
acceptance: Insights never duplicate
Resolved insights reopen only if the condition returns

steps.title: Editable settings
steps.summary: Edit insight thresholds, rate card and workspace preferences with validation and audit.
acceptance: Every change validated and audited
